name: DW Picha Changelog
author: Dango Web

sections.description:
With this plugin, you can create a changelog for your product or software.
Picha is a WordPress plugin designed to showcase the changes in physical or digital products in the most engaging way possible for users. With Picha, the era of dry and boring changelogs is over. Software developers, product managers, and website owners can now present their updates and changes in an attractive, user-friendly format.

Picha simplifies the process of creating and displaying complex updates. It allows users to directly upload and register their changelog text files into the plugin. Once registered, Picha transforms the textual content into a visually appealing changelog using a variety of beautifully designed themes. Managers can then use the generated shortcode to display the changelog anywhere on their site. This eliminates the need for tedious manual design work, enabling them to focus on delivering key information to their audience effectively.
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Take advantage from Picha (changelog)
sections.changelog:
2.0

  • Added Pro version features
  • Add bulk logs
  • Add more templates
  • Add Jalali date
  • Added the ability to add descriptions for each version

1.0

  • Initial release.
